name: The Orchid Show 2026: Christian Sampson
blurb: Selby Gardens' signature fall exhibition fills its bayfront conservatory with orchid installations by artist Christian Sampson. Admission is $28 for adults, $12 for ages 5–17, and free for members and kids 4 and under.
photo_credit: Photo: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens / Sarasota Magazine

name: Sophisticated Ladies at Westcoast Black Theatre Troupe
hours_label: Tue–Fri 7:30 PM, Sat 2 & 7:30 PM, Sun 2 PM · $60 adults, $25 students/military
blurb: WBTT opens its season with Sophisticated Ladies, a high-energy musical revue celebrating the songs of Duke Ellington, staged in the troupe's Rosemary District theater. Tickets are $60 for adults and $25 for students and active military.
photo_credit: Photo: Westcoast Black Theatre Troupe / VisitSarasota.com

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Florida's iconic downtown market with local produce, flowers, baked goods and prepared foods. Free to browse, a perfect Saturday-morning stroll through downtown Sarasota.

name: Trick or Treat on the Lake
hours_label: 4:30 – 7:30 PM · See event page for admission
blurb: Nathan Benderson Park's family Halloween night sends costumed kids along a lakeside candy trail of community-decorated booths, with an interactive play area, storytelling corner and live music. Check the event page for admission details.
